name: tomtoc
description: Tech-carry brand founded in 2016 making laptop bags, slings, sleeves and travel organizers built around tech protection and organization, sold through its own US store.

evidence.summary: tomtoc's own affiliate program page recruits creators, publishers and content partners, describes the apply-approve-link-share-earn flow, states there is NO minimum earnings threshold for payout, pays via PayPal only, and notes tomtoc.com currently ships within the United States only.
The same page directs discount-code and affiliate questions to the Affiliate Team at support@tomtoc.com.

tomtoc's own Refersion portal lists the program terms: 10.00% base commission on sales, 30-day attribution window, percent-of-sale model, no minimum payout, PayPal payment; an Awin merchant profile for tomtoc corroborates a 10% base rate and 30-day cookie.

No earnings-cap statement appears on the fetched brand page or portal listing (the 'no minimum' line is a payout threshold, not an earnings cap), so commission_cap is unknown; no absolute creator-count evidence is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

opportunity.title: tomtoc Affiliate Program - 10% via its own Refersion portal (apply on the brand page or portal)

reasons.niche_fit: Pure tech-carry brand (laptop bags, slings, EDC organizers) - a staple category for tech and everyday-carry creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page explicitly recruits content creators across YouTube, blogs and social media and offers campaign partnerships and marketing assets.
reasons.compensation: Published 10% base commission on the brand's Refersion portal with a 30-day window and no minimum payout threshold.
reasons.contact_access: A named Affiliate Team email (support@tomtoc.com) is published on the brand's own program page, plus an open application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application; the brand states applications are reviewed in the second half of each month.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016, established DTC brand selling through its own US store.
